effects.mayPay: Pay X life (the spell's mana value) to create a 1/1 Hero token with X +1/+1 counters?

abilities.text: Throw Wide the Gates — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay X life, where X is that spell's mana value. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token and put X +1/+1 counters on it. Do this only once each turn.
